description: This Java source file contains utility methods for command building and argument parsing within the Spark launcher module, including environment variable handling, string quoting, version parsing, and argument redaction.

classes.name: CommandBuilderUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for command argument handling, environment variable management, string quoting, version parsing, and argument redaction in Spark launcher.

methods.name: isEmpty

methods.name: firstNonEmpty
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty string from a list of candidates.

methods.name: getLibPathEnvName
methods.description: Returns the environment variable name for native library paths based on OS.

methods.name: parseOptionString

methods.description: Throws an exception if a condition is false.
